Bollywood Celebrities Celebrate Ganesh Chaturthi

Bollywood celebrities marked the Ganesh Chaturthi festival with enthusiasm. Kareena Kapoor Khan shared glimpses of Lord Ganesha, while Saif Ali Khan was seen making an idol with his son Jeh. One report highlighted a past miraculous experience of actress Surbhi Chandna during the festival, expressing gratitude for Lord Ganesha's arrival. Another piece offered a creative suggestion for making eco-friendly chocolate idols of Lord Ganesha for the occasion.
